records.title: Promotion builder syntax initialization
records.failure: The first builder used a colon instead of an equals sign in one constant initializer.
records.recovery: Correct only the initializer in a separately retained builder and compile before execution.
records.guard: Compile every generated control script before it writes.

records.title: Promotion catalogue source path
records.failure: The v2 builder joined an owner-relative path to the promotion root twice after source files were created.
records.recovery: Hash owner-relative catalogue sources from the owner root and reuse only byte-identical partial source files.
records.guard: Declare each stored path domain and join it to exactly one matching root.

records.title: Promotion raw core byte domain
records.failure: The v1 promotion writer JSON-serialized a Buffer, so all runners refused the core binding.
records.recovery: Create additive collision-free v2 skills, runners, and raw core without changing v1.
records.guard: Byte-copy runtime sources explicitly; generic JSON writers may not receive Buffer values.
